changelog:
- Initial release of the Study Habits skill.
- Enables study session tracking with topics, duration, and confidence ratings.
- Recommends evidence-based study techniques (active recall, spaced repetition, interleaving, more).
- Provides intelligent spaced repetition reminders for optimal review timing.
- Offers a progress dashboard with study stats, retention trends, and mastery levels.
- Generates personalized exam prep schedules with countdowns and review cycles.
summary: Build effective study habits with spaced repetition, active recall, and session tracking
